evidence.note: LoGAR reframes multimodal misinformation detection as logic-guided verification: a VLM first generates an explicit rationale specifying what to verify, which then conditions both multimodal feature fusion (filtering irrelevant visual/textual signals) and message passing over a heterogeneous social graph (down-weighting neighbors semantically dissonant with the verification hypothesis), with an RL-trained adaptive-depth policy that stops graph reasoning once sufficient evidence has accumulated -- beating the strongest baseline by 5.40%/5.18% AUC on Weibo/PHEME while cutting relative FLOPs to 0.57x and improving throughput 1.7x versus fixed-depth reasoning.
evidence.title: Do Not Guess, Verify: Logic-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Multimodal Misinformation Detection
